Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: SOC 2 / security follow-up + requested artifacts

Hi Sara / Ben —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery so the right people are looped in:

Key pain points you called out:
- Need predictable, auditable inference for user PII-heavy workloads (audit logs + retention policy)
- Procurement needs SOC 2 Type II evidence and pen test summary for security review
- Data residency / encryption at rest + KMS integration are gating items for legal/compliance

Goals we heard:
- Baseline: platform must provide per-request audit logs and 90/180-day retention configurable by route
- Security: SOC 2 Type II report, pen test summary, and a standard DPA to review by the end of next week
- Timeline: procurement kickoff mid-July if artifacts meet requirements

What we’re sharing now (attachments + drive link):
1) Redwood_SOC2_SAAS_Report_Q1_2026.pdf — redacted SOC 2 Type II report (control mapping included)
2) redwood-pen-test-summary.pdf — executive pen test summary and remediation tracker
3) redwood-dpa-draft.docx — our standard DPA template (editable)

Technical notes for your security team:
- Audit logs: per-request logs include request id, model version, route, token counts, request metadata. Retention is configurable at the customer route level; defaults to 90 days.
- Encryption: customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256; we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and HSM integrations for Private deployments.
- Pen test: third-party pen tests performed Q1'26; summary attached. Full report available under NDA — happy to arrange.

Proposed next steps:
- Please confirm which artifacts you want us to add to the shared drive (full SOC 2 package under NDA?)
- Legal to review DPA — we can accept markups; I'll send a DocuSign envelope if you prefer signature flow
- Schedule a 30-min call with your security lead + our security engineer (Rishi) to walk the audit log format and retention options — proposed slots Tues/Wed next week (6/23-6/24).

Thanks — leaving Rishi and Dev on-thread for any technical or procurement details.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.example.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 / security follow-up + requested artifacts

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and for sending the documents. A couple quick clarifications from our security and procurement teams after a first pass:

1) SOC 2: we can review the redacted report, but procurement will want the full SOC 2 Type II package under NDA. Please confirm process and expected turnaround.
2) Audit logs: we need to validate the schema — specifically the fields for user identifiers (masked vs. raw), timestamps (UTC), and retention controls per-route.
3) DPA: we will share initial markups. Two must-haves: data deletion SLA and subprocessor disclosure clause.
4) Pen test: the summary is helpful. Our security lead may request the full report and evidence of remediation for high/critical findings.

We are aiming to present to our legal & infosec committee on 30 Jun, so if we can get the remaining artifacts and a 30-min technical walkthrough early next week that would be ideal.

Can Rishi join the walkthrough (audit log schema + KMS options)? If you can propose specific time slots, I'll coordinate with our security lead.

—Sara
Sara Lim
Security & Compliance Manager
Acme Corp
sara.lim@acme.example.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 / security follow-up + requested artifacts

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the notes. Quick answers and items we'll action this week: 

- Full SOC 2 package: we can provide the full SOC 2 Type II package under a mutual NDA. I will loop our legal team and initiate the NDA today — expected turnaround 1-2 business days once countersigned.

- Audit log schema: attached is a CSV export sample and an outline below of the exact fields we record (request_id, route, model_version, request_timestamp_utc, requester_id_masked, requester_role, token_count, response_hash). We store timestamps in UTC and can provide logs in JSON/CSV.

- Retention controls: default 90 days, optional 180 days or custom retention for Dedicated/Private customers. We can support per-route overrides and provide an export for e-discovery.

- KMS / encryption: we support AWS KMS customer-managed keys for hosted and Dedicated; for Private deployments customers can bring HSM keys. We also support tenant-scoped keys for enterprises.

- Pen test: full report is available under NDA. Summary attached (redwood-pen-test-summary.pdf). We tracked remediation; high/critical items were closed within 30 days of discovery.

Proposed walkthrough slots (30 mins):
- Tue 2026-06-23 10:00-10:30 PT
- Tue 2026-06-23 15:00-15:30 PT
- Wed 2026-06-24 09:00-09:30 PT

Please let us know which works and whether you prefer a shared Google Drive folder (we already created one) or we should send the full SOC 2 under a separate secure transfer once NDA is signed.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
